subject: Fragmented continents + principal continental masses; partial reconstruction of Orbina world map
v219_correction: Moved western source landmass #8 south-west and repositioned southern #6/#7; intact envelope polygons were checked against protected core and each other for crossings before applying clipping.
construction: Retain source polygon and its original relative relief. Fracture bands are irregular strips in source SVG coordinates. Each retained side is a separate independently editable SVG fragment group with a source polygon clip; the removed strip displays as open seawater. No artificial isthmus to connect whole continents.

transformation_scope: Eight prior outer candidate source polygons, of which #1 #4 #7 are fractured; central supercontinent untouched in source shape.
notes: Fracture clip regions visually divide an existing polygon into separate SVG editable graphics; source outline itself is never modified.
Fracture strips remove land pixels in candidate map, and thus require future river catchment and coastal edge recomputation if formally adopted.
No claim that global break-up mechanics, seabed bathymetry, volcanic arcs, mountain belts, current direction or climate zones has been simulated.
The eastern, northern, and southern fragment placement represents candidate geomorphology, not canonical planetary continents or borders.
Candidate sea labels in design are descriptors, not the 25 official mapped ocean names.
Three groups of candidate island chains are independent from the 32 named chain structure of 碎洋.
No literary site content is altered.
next_review: Inspect fragment coast naturalness, unwanted land collisions, sea opening on core, continuity of landforms, island collisions, and need to regenerate affected synthetic water systems.
